messages.content: Explain what photosynthesis does for a plant. Answer in two to four sentences of plain prose.

message.content: Photosynthesis is the process that allows plants to make their own food so they can grow and survive. By capturing sunlight, plants convert water and carbon dioxide into a sugar called glucose, which serves as their main source of energy. This vital process provides the plant with the fuel it needs to build new leaves, roots, and flowers.
